checkedAlternates.risk: DROP TABLE removes data like DELETE.
checkedAlternates.resolution: DROP TABLE removes the table schema itself (DDL, group-3), whereas DELETE removes rows (DML, group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Some classifications group SELECT under DML.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Standard SQL textbooks separate SELECT as DQL (group-1) from row-modifying DML statements (group-4).
